notes: Sources we deliberately do not poll. Each entry records why, so the decision is not silently reversed later. Link-out means the app may reference them but never ingests them.

excluded.name: Remotive
excluded.reason: robots.txt disallows /api/*; API terms forbid republishing Remotive jobs to third-party job sites

excluded.name: Reddit (r/forhire, r/WorkOnline)
excluded.reason: robots.txt Disallow: /; Public Content Policy restricts automated and commercial use; unauthenticated requests return 429 quickly

excluded.name: Jobberman
excluded.reason: robots disallows /job/ detail pages and filter query strings; Cloudflare + Laravel

excluded.name: Upwork
excluded.reason: RSS returns 403; no public jobs API; ToS prohibits automated scraping

excluded.name: LinkedIn
excluded.reason: ToS and anti-bot measures prohibit automated collection; no free public job API

excluded.name: Indeed
excluded.reason: ToS and anti-bot measures prohibit automated collection; no free public job API

excluded.name: Wellfound (AngelList)
excluded.reason: Heavy anti-bot protection; no public API

excluded.name: Prolific
excluded.reason: Participant pool limited to selected countries; Nigeria is not supported

excluded.name: Remotasks
excluded.reason: Discontinued operations in Nigeria in March 2024

excluded.name: Fiverr
excluded.reason: No public task feed; Buyer Requests discontinued — nothing to poll

excluded.name: PeoplePerHour / Contra
excluded.reason: HTML-only, robots restricts query URLs, thin Nigeria-specific volume
